metrics.label: Received throughput
metrics.note: The only throughput compared across stacks. The gNB's own MAC bitrate (OCUDU) and goodput (OAI) are not the same quantity and are not plotted.

metrics.label: Loss
metrics.note: Log by default: a good run and a bad one differ by orders of magnitude.

metrics.label: PUSCH SNR
metrics.note: PUCCH SNR is OAI-only and is deliberately not offered.

metrics.label: Residual BLER DL
metrics.note: First-transmission BLER is OAI-only and is deliberately not offered.

metrics.label: Residual BLER UL
metrics.note: First-transmission BLER is OAI-only and is deliberately not offered.

metrics.label: MCS DL
metrics.note: Shown with the stack's cap, and with the modulation table on the axis.

metrics.label: MCS UL
metrics.note: Shown with the stack's cap, and with the modulation table on the axis.

metrics.label: CQI
metrics.note: Reported against each gNB's own CSI-RS configuration, so a cross-vendor difference is not necessarily a channel difference.

metrics.label: RI DL
metrics.note: Always direction-labelled. OCUDU reports a mean, OAI an instantaneous value.

not_offered.reason: first-transmission BLER is OAI-only, so it is not comparable across stacks
